query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.chat_conversations ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), participant_one UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, participant_two UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, relationship_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (relationship_type IN ('customer_merchant', 'customer_courier', 'merchant_courier')), reference_id UUID, last_message_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT unique_conversation_participants UNIQUE (participant_one, participant_two, relationship_type, reference_id) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.chat_messages ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), conversation_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.chat_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, sender_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, content TEXT NOT NULL, is_read BOOLEAN DEFAULT false, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now() ); ALTER TABLE public.chat_conversations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE public.chat_messages ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
